description: This file defines interfaces and a class related to broadcast channel subscriptions within the Orleans framework. It includes the IBroadcastChannelSubscription interface, an event handler interface, and an internal class implementing the subscription logic.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelSubscription
classes.description: An internal class implementing the IBroadcastChannelSubscription interface, representing a subscription to a broadcast channel, managing attachment logic with the consumer extension.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches event handlers for published messages and errors to the consumer extension.
